title: marattia howeana
intro: Marattia howeana, commonly known as the Marattia fern, is a species of fern in the family Marattiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Marattia howeana are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe and protect the skin. The bioactive constituents of Marattia howeana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
